Reclaim 0.1.1 - free Mac public alpha

Download the universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13 or later. No account or payment is required to download.

## Install
1. Download Reclaim-0.1.1-macOS-universal.dmg.
2. Open the DMG and drag Reclaim into Applications.
3. Open Reclaim from Applications. Keep macOS security protections enabled.
4. Start with disposable files and test restore before reviewing important data. Keep a current backup.

## This build
- Current October 6 source snapshot, including quarantine permission handling and recovery safeguards.
- Automatic permanent deletion is off by default, including upgrades from legacy retention settings. Enabling it requires explicit typed confirmation.
- Developer ID signed, accepted by Apple notarization, with tickets stapled to both the app and DMG.
- 84 frontend tests, 51 native tests, type checking, and browser retention-consent checks passed. One existing live-disk test was intentionally not run.
- Core file review/cleanup is local; optional AI assistance requires your own configured provider. The browser companion remains read-only.

## Alpha limitations
Physical Intel Macs, clean-machine installs, upgrades and the oldest supported macOS have not been fully qualified. Notarization checks distribution security, not freedom from bugs or data loss. Review every cleanup selection, test recovery, and back up important files. Permanent emptying cannot be undone.

Report issues: https://thecreatingco.com/testing/?product=reclaim#feedback
